findings.claim: Signed favorable-minus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes and over the whole observed window are strongest for pair-distance shell densities at short separations: pair_kernel_1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 have positive whole-window integrated z with q<0.001 and positive batch fractions of 1.0, while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (integrated z -0.485, q=1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 0.0). These are selection-enrichment contrasts on a standardized coordinate feature, not an absolute geometric descriptor and not a physical interaction energy.

Landmark soft-min distances and occupancy shells carry signed contrasts at the observed selection nodes: soft-min at landmarks 00, 02, 03, 05, 06, 12, 15, 16 and 18 is positive (favorable side closer), while soft-min at landmarks 04, 10, 14 and 19 is negative; occupancy3/occupancy5 at landmarks 00, 04, 07, 10, 13, 15, 16, 18 and 19 is negative. Occupancy is a radial shell density peaking at a=3 or 5 A, not an atom count and not monotone in distance, so these signs are not a shared quality axis.

Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity: decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false and lineage_support states the multiple-testing correction is over survival field/measure tests and is not terminal affinity effects. Survival enrichment is positive for landmark_00_soft_mass (z=0.365, q=0.120) and landmark_02_local_dz (z=0.206, q=0.356) and negative for landmark_05_local_czz (z=-0.419, q=0.120), landmark_09_local_czz (z=-0.390, q=0.120), landmark_14_local_czz (z=-0.308, q=0.120) and landmark_16_local_cyy (z=-0.317, q=0.219). The immediate selection contrast and the descendant survival credit disagree in sign for several of these features, so last-record credit must not be presented as final affinity benefit.

Parent-child increment contrasts and the turnover residual disagree with the population contrasts for several features. Increment effects are negative for shape_xx (z=-3.70, q=0.095), shape_yy (z=-3.85, q=0.161), pair_kernel_7.0 (z=-3.14, q=0.208), landmark_00_softmin (z=-4.91, q=0.046), landmark_03_occupancy5 (z=-3.02, q=0.161), landmark_06_occupancy5 (z=-2.87, q=0.256) and landmark_16_occupancy3 (z=-1.75, q=0.222), and positive for shape_xz (z=3.00, q=0.207), pair_kernel_2.5 (z=3.96, q=0.208), landmark_00_occupancy3 (z=4.28, q=0.081) and landmark_13_occupancy5 (z=2.48, q=0.279). The turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or an atom velocity.

Joint-motion diagnostics separate local coordinate information from global pose and shape. Under adjusted covariance, joint_innovation_RMS_A (z=-3.60e-5, q=0.020, same-sign batch fraction 0.93) and joint_internal_RMS_A (z=-3.42e-5, q=0.030, same-sign batch fraction 0.93) are negative, while joint_translation_RMS_A is weaker (z=-8.99e-6, q=0.072). The joint diagnostics report teacher_contrast_internal_fraction 0.787 and teacher_contrast_translation_fraction 0.132, and selection innovation is negatively associated with observed_child_score_gain (z=-0.036, q=1.8e-7). These are supplied adjusted/joint diagnostics; the region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.

Coherent joint coordinate patterns are distinguishable from isolated marginal descriptors. Under adjusted covariance, pair_kernel_1.5 (z=7.67e-7, q=0.081) and pair_kernel_2.5 (z=1.14e-6, q=0.077) remain positive with same-sign batch fractions of 0.79, and under adjusted correlation pair_kernel_1.5 (z=0.101, q=0.019) and pair_kernel_2.5 (z=0.084, q=0.046) remain positive with same-sign batch fractions of 0.93. shape_yy is negative under both raw and adjusted correlation (z=-0.103 and -0.100, q=1.5e-5 and 0.015, same-sign batch fraction 1.0). The joint diagnostics report teacher_contrast_coherence 0.812 and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment 0.226 (q=2.2e-9).

The whole-window integrated contrast is the appropriate stationary summary: continuous_functions defines the observable as a favorable-minus-comparison coordinate feature standardized by original feature scale, with observed support [0.0,0.49] and linear interpolation within that support only. The supplied continuous trends show substantial time variation (first-rate and last-rate z of opposite sign, sign changes and strong sign conflicts at many nodes), and curve_support reports relative node RMSE of 0.39-0.93 with strong sign conflict nodes up to 15 and legendre_runtime_allowed false for every audited feature. No time-conditioned reward information is proposed.

Population-contrast changes and parent-child increment contrasts with their turnover residual are reported separately. For landmark_00_local_cxx the population rate is -0.058 (p=0.86), the edge rate is -4.34 (p=0.004) and the turnover residual is +4.29 (p=0.002); for landmark_00_local_cyy the population rate is 0.258 (p=0.62), the edge rate is -4.79 (p=0.006) and the residual is +5.05 (p=0.001). The residual is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or an atom velocity, and the evidence does not separate within-path change from changing cohort composition.

The information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A of 0.081 A (batch bootstrap CI 0.070-0.092) and compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation of 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140), with the stated limitation that nonnegative excess distance is by construction and is not a causal affinity effect. The joint diagnostics for teacher_contrast_RMS_A, teacher_contrast_coherence, teacher_control_root_ESS, teacher_score_gap, teacher_noise_RMS_A, teacher_lower_rejected_fraction, teacher_expected_probability_advantage, teacher_sign_calibration_cosine, teacher_contrast_rotation_fraction and teacher_contrast_atom_participation_fraction are descriptive within-selector associations with null_tested false and no p or q values, so they cannot be ranked as uncertainty-adjusted hypotheses.

Global centroid coordinates do not survive multiplicity adjustment: under adjusted covariance global_centroid_x, y and z have q of 0.965, 0.864 and 0.913, and under adjusted correlation q of 0.812, 0.740 and 0.534, with same-sign batch fractions of 0.43-0.64. The endpoint effects for global_centroid_y are negative (integrated z -0.243, q=0.014, positive batch fraction 0.21) but the adjusted branch evidence does not support a centroid direction.

Shape components are mostly not supported after adjustment: shape_xx, shape_zz, shape_xy, shape_xz and shape_yz have adjusted-covariance q of 0.356, 0.454, 0.470, 0.465 and 0.255 and adjusted-correlation q of 0.299, 0.584, 0.410, 0.887 and 0.520. shape_yy is the exception, negative under raw covariance (z=-7.17e-5, q=0.153), adjusted covariance (z=-4.73e-5, q=0.131), raw correlation (z=-0.103, q=0.0026) and adjusted correlation (z=-0.100, q=0.015), with same-sign batch fraction 1.0 in the correlation views.

Pair-kernel shells show a distance-graded pattern rather than a single direction: short shells 1.5 and 2.5 A are positive under raw covariance (q=0.134 and 0.116), adjusted covariance (q=0.081 and 0.077), raw correlation (q=0.027 and 0.041) and adjusted correlation (q=0.019 and 0.046), while the 7.0 A shell is negative under raw correlation (z=-0.055, q=0.095) and adjusted correlation (z=-0.050, q=0.129). The 3.5 and 5.0 A shells are not supported after adjustment (adjusted-covariance q=0.534 and 0.449).

hypotheses.claim: Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast of pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 at the observed selection nodes over the whole observed window; intended response is a positive shift in those short-shell contrasts; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward with the declared detached matching convention; spatial scale is the 1.5-2.5 A pair-distance shell and temporal scale is the full observed window [0.0,0.49]; discriminating failure condition is a null or negative whole-window integrated contrast with same-sign batch fraction below 0.5 in the independent batches. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the registered pointcloud endpoint reward with a region_index bound to an evidence-bound landmark and pointcloud_delta_A in {0.5,1.0,2.0}; the pair-kernel term itself is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the signed contrast of landmark soft-min distance and occupancy3/occupancy5 shells at the observed selection nodes; intended response is a positive shift in soft-min contrast at landmarks 00, 02, 03, 05, 06, 12, 15, 16 and 18 and a negative shift in occupancy shells at landmarks 00, 04, 07, 10, 13, 15, 16, 18 and 19; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the 3-5 A radial shell around the named landmark and temporal scale is the full observed window; discriminating failure condition is a sign reversal of the whole-window integrated contrast or a same-sign batch fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the registered pointcloud endpoint reward with a region_index bound to an evidence-bound landmark; occupancy and soft-min are not monotone in distance and are not a shared quality axis.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the joint internal and innovation RMS contrast under adjusted covariance; intended response is a negative shift in joint_internal_RMS_A and joint_innovation_RMS_A while joint_translation_RMS_A is left free; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the internal coordinate extent and temporal scale is the full observed window; discriminating failure condition is a null or positive adjusted joint-internal contrast with same-sign batch fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the registered pointcloud endpoint reward with a region_index bound to an evidence-bound landmark; the joint-motion diagnostics are not themselves a reward term.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the whole-window integrated contrast of a stationary coordinate rule; intended response is a positive shift in the integrated contrast; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the named landmark region and temporal scale is the full observed window; discriminating failure condition is a null or negative integrated contrast with same-sign batch fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the registered temporal teacher blend with temporal_region_index bound to an evidence-bound landmark and verified continuous salience and temporal_teacher_blend in {0.25,0.5,1.0}; the supplied continuous trends show substantial time variation and curve_support reports legendre_runtime_allowed false, so a time-conditioned reward is not supported.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the parent-child increment contrast and its turnover residual for the named feature; intended response is a positive shift in the increment contrast; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the named landmark region and temporal scale is the full observed window; discriminating failure condition is a null or negative increment contrast with same-sign batch fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the registered pointcloud endpoint reward with a region_index bound to an evidence-bound landmark; the turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic and is not a causal selection effect or an atom velocity.

Testable coordinate intervention: observable is the signed contrast of pair-kernel shells at 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0 and 7.0 A; intended response is a positive shift in the short shells and a negative shift in the 7.0 A shell; target origin is the endpoint pointcloud reward; spatial scale is the pair-distance shell and temporal scale is the full observed window; discriminating failure condition is a sign reversal of the whole-window integrated contrast or a same-sign batch fraction below 0.5. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the registered pointcloud endpoint reward with a region_index bound to an evidence-bound landmark; the pair-kernel term is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Occupancy shells are radial densities peaking at a=3 or 5 A, not atom counts and not monotone in distance.
Pair kernels are radial pair-distance shell densities, not bond labels or interaction energies.
Joint diagnostics without null_tested true have no p or q values and cannot be ranked as uncertainty-adjusted hypotheses.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; those effects are diagnostic evidence only.
